blocks.text: SB19 and BINI emerged as the biggest winners at the second edition of the Filipino Music Awards, which was held on Tuesday, October 6, in Pasay City. BINI was named Artist of the Year. The girl group also won Tour of the Year for its “Signals World Tour 2026.” Members Maloi and Jhoanna were the only ones present to receive their respective group awards. SB19, meanwhile, took home People’s Choice – Artist and People’s Choice – Song for “VISA.” The group also won Concert of the Year for “Wakas At Simula: The Trilogy Concert Finale.” READ: SB19’s ‘Wakas at Simula’ journey […]...
